claim_type: explicit stability inequality with sharpness (emergent special case)
limitations: Commuting (simultaneously diagonalizable) Gaussian marginals with spectra in (0,M] only; excludes non-commuting covariances and non-Gaussian strongly log-concave marginals, so the full target remains open. C1(r) grows like r^2 as eps->0; two-sided constant has factor-2 triangle-inequality looseness. Sharpness is r->0 asymptotic exactness only; no exact-r^2-coefficient claim.
provenance: Independent SCOPE audit of EMERGENT_FINDING from target work on dimension-free W2 stability of entropic plans; proof re-verified line-by-line and numeric audit re-executed.
record_title: Dimension-free W2 stability of entropic plans for commuting Gaussians with explicit constant C1(r)=1+(1+4F*^2)r^2
